title: Station hello answer
description: The hub's 200 answer to GET /api/station/hello (Hub.handle, sizeup/cloud/hub.py): the bearer token works, and as which station. The request has no body. It is the station's Test connection: answered by a standby hub and for a station that is not the hub's primary, and it never counts as the station being connected. The station reads only the outcome (2xx or not), not the body.

station.description: The station id the token proves; "" for a shared token that has not been given an id yet.

token.description: The kind of token: `own`, the station's own (sz1.<id>.<secret>), or `shared`, the hub's shared station token.
